# Tek's Domain

> > A technical blog exploring programming, networking, amateur radio, and analog photography with a focus on privacy, decentralized systems, and hands-on experimentation.

Tek's Domain is a personal technical website covering diverse interests including server administration, ham radio operations (POTA activations), film photography, and decentralized communication protocols. The site emphasizes privacy-first tools, federation technologies, and practical guides for technical enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Amateur Radio (Ham Radio)
- POTA Activations
- Privacy & Encryption
- Matrix Messaging
- Federation & Decentralization
- Film Photography
- Analog Processing
- IPv6 Networking
- Mail Server Security
- Fail2Ban Configuration
- XMPP/Jabber
- OTR Protocol
- PeerTube
- Postfix
- Reverse Proxy

## Amateur Radio & POTA

- [Let's Ham It up a Little](https://teknikaldomain.me/post/ham-it-up): Beginner's guide to amateur radio licensing and terminology for hobbyists.
- [First Amateur Activity: POTA Activation With 92 Contacts, 6 Hours](https://teknikaldomain.me/post/hf-pota): Amateur radio POTA activation report with 92 HF contacts from Bulgaria.

## Server Administration & Security

- [Fail2Ban Behind a Reverse Proxy: The Almost-Correct Way](https://teknikaldomain.me/code/reverse-proxy-f2b): Technical guide for configuring Fail2Ban with reverse proxy and IP filtering.
- [AbuseIPDB Checking With Postfix](https://teknikaldomain.me/code/postfix-abuseipdb): Mail server security guide integrating AbuseIPDB with Postfix for spam filtering.

## Networking & Protocols

- [What Exactly Is Federation, Anyways?](https://teknikaldomain.me/post/what-is-federation): Explanation of federation in decentralized systems like Matrix, XMPP, and ActivityPub.
- [IPv6 Is a Total Nightmare — This is Why](https://teknikaldomain.me/post/ipv6-is-a-total-nightmare): Critical analysis of IPv6 protocol design and comparison with IPv4.

## Film Photography & Video

- [Videoes](https://teknikaldomain.me/video): Video content hub featuring film photography and analog processing on PeerTube.
- [A Professional Amateur Develops Color Film](https://teknikaldomain.me/video/first-time-color-film-dev): PeerTube video documenting color film development process and techniques.

## Site Updates & Features

- [What's Changed: Bilberry Theme Version 4](https://teknikaldomain.me/post/theme-version-4): Hugo Bilberry theme v4 changelog detailing improvements and new features.
- [Narration for Posts, for You!](https://teknikaldomain.me/post/narration): Audio narration feature implementation using HTML5 for post accessibility.

## Community & Support

- [Contact](https://teknikaldomain.me/page/contact): Contact information and communication channels including Matrix, email, and PGP encryption.
- [Errata](https://teknikaldomain.me/page/errata): Error reporting and correction submission process with community leaderboard.
- [Donations Box](https://teknikaldomain.me/page/donations-box): Donation and funding options via Ko-fi and other payment methods.
